title: DeepSeek-R1 joins the text models
summary:
DeepSeek-R1 was added, the community showcase got its projects back, and submitting an app became less of a scavenger hunt.

Added the reasoning-enabled `deepseek-r1` chat model. `llamalight` now uses Llama 3.1 8B through Cloudflare, while `p1` was removed from the model list. The text API’s per-IP queue cap was removed, and image request queues were adjusted.

The Projects page now has a Submit Your Project button that opens a structured GitHub issue form. The README links to the form too, replacing the previous email-based submission route.

Projects missing after the previous UI update were restored and organized into categories covering integrations, creative apps, tools, bots, libraries, and tutorials. The README project list and image-generation figures were updated, and the website footer now identifies Pollinations as open source and based in Berlin.

highlights.title: DeepSeek-R1 joins the models
highlights.text: Try reasoning-enabled chat with `deepseek-r1`, based on DeepSeek-R1 Distill Qwen 32B. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=deepseek-r1).

highlights.title: Submit your project
highlights.text: Built something with Pollinations? The Projects page now has a Submit Your Project button that opens a GitHub issue form. [Explore projects](https://pollinations.ai).
